author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The lookup template forwards an iframe-load callback that intentionally performs no work.
findings.consequence: The prop chain enlarges the component API and implies a load transition that does not exist.
findings.evidence: The template passes an empty composable callback that the dialog invokes on iframe load.
findings.recommendation: Remove the callback chain and retain authenticated postMessage plus timeout as the only state transitions.
verification: Traced the lookup binding through composable, dialog prop, iframe listener, and tests.
Generated and read the exact current template packet and full component after the focus fix.
Inspected failure focus generations, route/unmount cleanup, generated API and sanitizer boundaries, dialog and notice semantics, component tests, legacy failure E2E, and embed security/focus E2E.
Confirmed the focus/message changes introduce no Critical or Important issue.
Used read-only inspection commands and made no repository edits.
